an3.100:6.1: What kind of individual does a trivial bad deed, but it lands them in hell?
an3.100:6.2: An individual who hasn’t developed their physical endurance, ethics, mind, or wisdom. They’re small-minded and mean-spirited, living in suffering.
an3.100:6.3: That kind of individual does a trivial bad deed, but it lands them in hell.
an3.100:7.1: What kind of individual does the same trivial bad deed, but experiences it in this life, so that not even a little remains, let alone a lot?
an3.100:7.2: An individual who has developed their physical endurance, ethics, mind, and wisdom. They’re not small-minded, but are big-hearted, meditating on the immeasurables.
